selected_script.angle: burner-side stovetop grease ring gets worse when scrubbed with a damp sponge and dish soap
selected_script.hook: Extreme close-up of a sticky amber grease ring beside a stovetop burner as a damp kitchen sponge with a tiny drop of dish soap pushes the grease around, leaving cloudy streaks and oily residue instead of lifting it.

timeline.0-3s: Extreme close-up of a greasy amber ring and splattered cooking oil around a stovetop burner; a damp sponge with dish soap scrubs but visibly fails, pushing the grease into cloudy streaks.
timeline.3-6s: The same sponge keeps scrubbing the same area with more pressure; the oily film spreads wider, small brown residue collects at the sponge edge, and the hand pauses in mild frustration.
timeline.6-10s: NUAN Heavy Duty Kitchen Degreaser Spray enters naturally beside the same burner, sprays foam onto the greasy ring, waits briefly, then wipes with a blue microfiber towel to reveal a clean surface; show the cleaned side next to a small untouched greasy edge as proof, ending with a light CTA.

scenes.promptText:
Create one complete approximately 10-second vertical TikTok-style UGC cleaning ad in 9:16, realistic handheld phone-shot style in a normal US home kitchen, natural indoor lighting, quick but believable pacing. Use the provided product reference images as the exact product identity for NUAN Heavy Duty Kitchen Degreaser Spray: white curved plastic trigger spray bottle, wide lower body, narrow neck, white ribbed collar, white trigger nozzle, glossy green front label with black NUAN logo near the top, large Heavy Duty Degreaser label text, small peach scent badge or peach icon, dirty kitchen grease image on the label, correct 500ml handheld proportions; preserve the color, label, shape, material, size ratio, logo position, texture, and visible structure from the references. Do not change the product color, shape, material, packaging proportions, label layout, logo position, or visible nozzle structure. Do not invent extra accessories, buttons, lights, attachments, or new functions. Use the function reference only to understand real spray-wait-wipe kitchen degreaser usage.

Timeline inside this single video: 0-3s: Start with an extreme close-up of a credible cleaning pain, not a product shot: a sticky amber-brown grease ring and tiny oil splatters baked beside a black stovetop burner on a stainless or enamel stovetop. A real hand uses a familiar ordinary method, a damp kitchen sponge with a tiny drop of dish soap, scrubbing in short circles. The method visibly fails: the grease smears into a cloudy oily film and leaves streaks instead of lifting. 3-6s: Continue the same failed method on the exact same greasy area. The hand presses harder and scrubs again; show the sponge dragging brown residue to the edge, the oily film spreading wider, and the surface looking dull and slippery. Add subtle realistic frustration through the hand stopping and turning the sponge, but keep it natural and not comedic. 6-10s: NUAN Heavy Duty Kitchen Degreaser Spray enters naturally from the side and is placed near the same burner. The hand sprays a realistic light foam coverage directly onto the same grease ring, waits a brief beat, then wipes with a blue microfiber towel in one or two firm passes. Show real cleaning action, not magical cleanup: grease loosens under the towel, residue transfers to the towel, and the stovetop becomes visibly cleaner. End with credible result proof: hold the camera close on the cleaned area beside a small untouched greasy edge or show the wiped clean strip next to the original smeared section for a believable before-after contrast. Finish with a light spoken CTA only, such as “Try it for greasy kitchen messes.” No subtitles, no UI, no stickers, no text overlays, no watermarks, no floating graphics, no invented props beyond ordinary sponge and blue microfiber towel, no exaggerated chemical reactions, no sparkling magic effect, no instant impossible transformation, no product drift.
